about:
Buhler Inc, the U.S. subsidiary of the Bühler Group, is headquartered in Plymouth, Minnesota. The Swiss parent company was founded in 1898 and has grown into a global supplier of process technologies and equipment.

The company designs and builds processing lines for food, feed, and advanced materials. Its portfolio covers grain milling, extrusion, cocoa and chocolate processing, pasta and snack production, as well as vacuum thin‑film coating, die casting, and wet grinding for batteries, semiconductors, and optical components. Buhler also provides lifecycle services including installation, maintenance, process optimization, upgrades, and a 24/7 hotline, supported by application and training centers such as the Milling Academy.

Customers span the food and feed sectors — animal feed, aqua feed, baked goods, dairy, pet food, and confectionery — and advanced‑materials industries such as battery electrode production, semiconductor packaging, automotive glass coating, and precision optics. Automotive OEMs including Volvo and Hyundai have adopted Bühler megacasting and die‑casting systems for vehicle components.

Bühler states that its innovations aim to create a better world with a focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions, citing energy‑saving developments like the Lucent cocoa roaster that cuts energy use by at least 20 percent while raising throughput.
